messages:
lara: Quick async check — runtime perf sprint status. Please drop short updates on: 1) kernel PRs blocking canary, 2) continuous batching rollout %, 3) KV prefetch health + owner. cc @dan @micah @anya

dan: Kernel PR #482 is gated on two CI flakes. I reduced batch mutex contention in the diff; canary build queued. Expect canary tomorrow. @micah can you review the syscall change?

micah: Reviewing now, found one potential race in the handshake path when two prefetch threads swap the same entry. I'll push a small fix and re-run bench. ETA ~4h.

anya: Continuous batching rollout at ~40% of fleet. Observed tail p99 latency spike for requests with seq_len > 1024. For now we're throttling batches over 512 tokens as a mitigation.

lara: Which job/config is doing the throttling? Need the exact key to audit rollout.

anya: It's in runtime-configs, group.canary: 
``
group.canary.batching.max_token_batch = 512
group.canary.kv_prefetch = true
```
(we patched the canary config yesterday).

micah: KV prefetch health: seeing a bump in small OOMs during warmup when prefetch concurrency > 8. Repro with the stress harness (kv_warmup_flood). Suspect cache eviction race + refcounting bug.

dan: Infra note — A100-80 instances for canary will be provisioned tomorrow but they require CUDA 12.3-compatible kernel build. Do we have a pinned runtime + kernel combo for that? If not, we should gate the instance swap.

lara: Eng-ML needs to confirm kernel/quantization compat. @anya are int8 kernels OK on 12.3?

anya: Quick sanity: most int8 kernels pass, but we hit one mmap compat issue on older allocator paths. Filing RNW-512 to track; will triage tomorrow AM.

micah: Proposed immediate actions: 
1) I'll open a tiny PR to fix the handshake race (this blocks kernel canary). ETA few hrs.
2) @dan please requeue the canary after PR merge and CI green.
3) @anya reduce kv_prefetch.concurrency -> 4 for the broader rollout as temporary rollback if OOMs persist.
4) @lara coordinate with eng-ml on RNW-512 and mark the ticket on the sprint board.

lara: Sounds good. I'll update the board and add owners. If infra needs me for the instance swap or CUDA gating, ping me directly. Thanks all — drop any short updates here if status changes. :thumbsup:
